title: Biden’s Halting Debate Performance Rattles Democrats
description_medium: At the June 27, 2024, presidential debate, Joe Biden appeared halting and struggled to complete some answers, while Donald Trump made a series of false claims. The contrast alarmed Democrats and raised new questions about Biden’s ability to continue his reelection campaign. It became a defining moment in the campaign’s final months.
description_long: The June 27, 2024, debate between President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump was the first general-election debate of the year and took place months earlier than usual. CNN moderators Jake Tapper and Dana Bash led the debate. Biden’s halting delivery and difficulty completing some answers quickly dominated post-debate discussion, while Trump repeated false or misleading claims during the event. Democrats expressed alarm about Biden’s age and capacity to campaign effectively, and the performance intensified calls within the party for him to reconsider his candidacy. Biden initially insisted he would remain in the race, but withdrew on July 21 and endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris. The debate did not by itself decide the election, but it precipitated a crisis in the Democratic campaign and changed the contest’s candidates. The debate performance and the political reaction to it should not be mistaken for a medical diagnosis.
